/*********************************************************************/
/* Includes                                                          */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/ipc.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

#pragma datamodel(P128)      /* @B1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants                                                         */
/*********************************************************************/

/* Semaphore operation flags */
#define SEM_UNDO   0X1000    /* Set up adjust on exit */

/* Command definitions for semctl() */
#define GETNCNT         3    /* Get semncnt for semaphore */
#define GETPID          4    /* Get sempid for semaphore */
#define GETVAL          5    /* Get semval for semaphore */
#define GETALL          6    /* Get semval for all semaphores */
#define GETZCNT         7    /* Get semzcnt for semaphore */
#define SETVAL          8    /* Set semval for semaphore */
#define SETALL          9    /* Set semval for all semaphores */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

/* Semaphore set information */
typedef struct semid_ds {
  struct ipc_perm sem_perm;  /* Permissions */
  unsigned short  sem_nsems; /* Number of semaphores in set */
#if ((defined _64_BIT_TIME) && (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 740))          /*@B2A*/
  time64_t        sem_otime; /* Time of last semop() */            /*@B2A*/
  time64_t        sem_ctime; /* Time of last change by semctl_time64() @B2A*/
#else                                                              /*@B2A*/
  time_t          sem_otime; /* Time of last semop() */
  time_t          sem_ctime; /* Time of last change by semctl() */
#endif                                                             /*@B2A*/
} semtablentry_t;

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 740)                                      /*@B2A*/
/* Semaphore set information */                                    /*@B2A*/
typedef struct semid_ds_time64 {                                   /*@B2A*/
  struct ipc_perm sem_perm;  /* Permissions */                     /*@B2A*/
  unsigned short  sem_nsems; /* Number of semaphores in set */     /*@B2A*/
  time64_t        sem_otime; /* Time of last semop() */            /*@B2A*/
  time64_t        sem_ctime; /* Time of last change by semctl_time64() @B2A*/
} semtablentry_time64_t;                                           /*@B2A*/
#endif                                                             /*@B2A*/

/* Semaphore */
typedef struct sem {
  unsigned int     semval;   /* Semaphore value */
  pid_t            sempid;   /* Process ID of last operation */
  unsigned short   semncnt;  /* Number of processes waiting for semval
                                to become greater than current value */
  unsigned short   semzcnt;  /* Number of processes waiting for semval
                                to become zero. */
} semaphore_t;

/* Semaphore operations */
struct sembuf {
  unsigned short  sem_num;   /* Semaphore number */
  short           sem_op;    /* Semaphore operation */
  short           sem_flg;   /* Operation flags */
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Function Prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN
    #ifdef __ILEC400__
         #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else
         #define QBFC_EXTERN extern "C"
    #endif

    #define __QBFC_EXTERN
#endif

QBFC_EXTERN int semctl(int semid, int semnum, int cmd, ...);
QBFC_EXTERN int semget(key_t key, int nsems, int semflg);
QBFC_EXTERN int semop(int semid, struct sembuf *sops, size_t nsops);

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=740)                                     /*@B2A*/
  #if ((!defined(_POSIX_SOURCE)) && (!defined(_POSIX1_SOURCE))) /*@B2A*/
       QBFC_EXTERN int semctl_time64(int semid, int semnum,
                                     int cmd, ...);             /*@B2A*/
	#ifdef _64_BIT_TIME                                     /*@B2A*/
            #pragma map(semctl, "semctl_time64")                /*@B2A*/
    	#endif                                                  /*@B2A*/
  #endif                                                        /*@B2A*/
#endif                                                          /*@B2A*/

#pragma datamodel(pop)       /* @B1A*/

#endif  /* _SEM_H */

  #pragma checkout(resume)
